description.label: Description
description.value:
Major Mental Mutation

Your mind has become so aberrant and foreign that you just don’t think like almost any other sentient entity. Attempts to determine your emotions, thoughts, motivations and Ambitions receive a -30 modifier and you get a +20 modifier to resist magic and abilities that try to influence or control your emotions or thoughts. Anyone using telepathy to create a connection with your mind must pass a Challenging (+0) Cool Test or gain the @Condition[Stunned] Condition. You make people around you deeply uncomfortable and you gain -20 Fellowship. You can only gain this mutation once.
